barTime.rule: time is the bar open in UTC; the bar closes barSeconds later
barTime.label: measured
barTime.source: the synthetic fixture's time column (fixtureCSV in e0_test.go): bar opens one minute apart from 2024-03-08T19:06:00Z, with one ten-minute gap

prices.rule: separate bid and ask OHLC per bar, from the owner's candles_ba export
prices.label: measured

spread.rule: a long enters at the ask open and exits on bid bars; a short enters at the bid open and exits on ask bars
spread.label: measured
spread.source: the export's bid and ask OHLC, per bar

commission.label: assumed
commission.source: docs/fill-spec.md, Spread and cost: commission defaults to 0

financingBasis.label: assumed
financingBasis.source: mean of the 2023 to 2025 DTB3 annual averages (5.07%, 4.97%, 4.07%) in docs/research/data.md

financingMarkup.label: assumed
financingMarkup.source: OANDA financing costs page in docs/research/sources.md: longs pay the basis plus 2.5% a year, shorts receive the basis minus 2.5%

financingRollover.rule: one day of financing (annual rate / 365, on the entry price) at each 17:00 America/New_York instant a position holds across, weekends included
financingRollover.label: assumed
financingRollover.source: the 17:00 America/New_York rollover time is an assumed industry convention; no page cited in docs/research/sources.md states it

decisionDelayMs.label: measured
decisionDelayMs.source: completion delay max over 12 bar transitions, https://github.com/mfittko/market-signals/pull/153
